🚨 TRAFFIC ADVISORY – IPL 2026 MATCHES (UPPAL) 🚨

In view of Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 cricket matches, a total of 07 matches are scheduled to be held on 05th, 13th, 18th, 21st April and 03rd, 06th, 22nd May 2026 at Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium, Uppal.

Moderate traffic congestion is expected in and around Uppal area. Accordingly, traffic diversions will be imposed within the limits of Uppal Traffic Police Station on match days to ensure smooth regulation of vehicular movement.

#TrafficAdvisory #IPL2026  #MalkajgiriPolice #RGIStadium #PublicAdvisory
